games.name: Wall Hop Frenzy [Practice]
games.desc:
😎 Play this game all the way through to be the BEST WALL HOP PRO in ROBLOX!

🔴 What's a Wall Hop? A wall hop is a glitch used to get an extra jump by jumping and turning on a wall stacked on top of each other!

🏃 118 Unique Stages!
🌎 Explore 7 Different Difficulties!
👆 Select any Stage!
🔒 Unlock Difficulties!
💪 Become a Wall Hop Pro!

⚠️💻 Setting your FPS to 60 is required to wall hop! (FPS can be accessed in the in-game roblox menu)

TONS of exciting wallhop stages ranging from easy to hard difficulty. Each stage you beat helps you become better at wall hopping. Wall Hop Frenzy is like a Difficulty Chart Obby, only you can select your stages within your difficulty. If you are stuck you can come back. If you are a skilled wall hop player you can try the harder stages in the game!

👍 We have tons of feedback saying this game has helped players become a pro wall hopper!

Please ⭐/👍 to help support the game!
